method: place anchors at (logTe_spec, M_G0_obs); mass = Mass of the nearest isochrone point in the (logTe, M_G0) plane under a chi metric (SIG_LOGTE=0.03 dex, SIG_MG0=0.40 mag) on the subgroup's fitted-age isochrone, per family; gate = chi<=2.5 for either family. Branch-robust where Teff folds at turnoff.
family_age_treatment: symmetric: each family uses its own independently fitted upper-MS MAP for each subgroup; all three baseline MIST fits happen to select the same 3.548-Myr native grid point, so MIST age_used is constant as a fit result rather than a fixed-age assumption
outlier_note: all 19 gate outliers are brighter than the isochrone (median -1.16 mag) - the unresolved-binary signature, consistent with the binary component of the CMD fit
